messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@datatek.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Purge Atlas project prompts/outputs + audit evidence

Hi Stephanie,

We're starting a regulated data cleanup for Project Atlas. Per our contract and the EU residency terms, we need Redwood to permanently purge ALL prompt inputs, model outputs, runtime logs, and associated KV cache entries that relate to the Atlas workspace (workspace id: atlas-7f2b).

Specifically we need:
- A complete deletion run that removes prompts, generated outputs, and any transient KV cache keys tied to atlas-7f2b.
- Deletion of S3 objects under s3://redwood-logs/eu/atlas-7f2b/ and related object versions.
- Audit evidence after the run: manifest of deleted objects, timestamps, and signed attestation that no residual prompt/output records remain in our account.

Please confirm scope, expected timeline, and the form of evidence you can provide (PDF attestation + machine-readable manifest preferred). We have a regulatory deadline the week after next, so a completion window within 7 business days would be ideal.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Engineering, DataTek AI
lena.ortiz@datatek.ai

[Attachment: project_atlas_scope.xlsx (xlsx)]

Team — forwarding DataTek's deletion request. Internal ask below.

Quick summary: customer requests full purge of Atlas workspace artifacts (prompts, outputs, runtime logs, KV cache entries) and a signed attestation + manifest. Region is EU; retention holds may apply. Please propose a concrete runbook with owner, timeline, and exact evidence we'll hand back.

Requirements to address in your runbook:
- Identify all storage locations (S3 prefixes, DB tables, audit logs, KV cache shards).
- Prevent reingestion or replay windows during purge (coordinate with routing layer).
- Produce a deletion_manifest.csv that lists deleted keys and timestamps.
- Provide a PDF attestation and a secure Drive link with raw deletion logs for audit.

Can you respond by EOD with a plan and earliest execution date? If compliance needs to be looped for attestations, call that out.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deletion runbook & tentative schedule (Atlas)

Thanks — plan below. High-level runbook that covers the customer's asks and gives a defensible audit trail.

Scope discovery (2 hours):
- Confirm workspace mapping: atlas-7f2b -> s3://redwood-logs/eu/atlas-7f2b/, db table prompts__atlas, outputs__atlas, stream_kv_shard_13..15.
- Snapshot current object counts and sizes (for manifest verification).

Execution (scheduled):
- Pre-checks: place retention hold on relevant partitions to block writes, take metadata snapshot.
- KV cache purge: run kvcache-purge job (job id: kvp-4821) targeting keys with tag atlas-7f2b.
- S3 object deletion: run S3 delete job that removes all object versions; capture s3 delete events.
- DB expunge: delete rows in prompts__atlas, outputs__atlas with pen-and-paper approval; create tombstone records for traceability.
- Runtime log scrub: rotate and remove/overwrite ephemeral logs and clear any aggregated indices.

Verification and evidence (post-run):
- Produce deletion_manifest.csv (attached) listing deleted object ids, DB row ids (hashed), and timestamps.
- Include sha256 hashes of deleted files before removal (redacted for PII) and s3 delete event IDs.
- Aggregate k8s job logs for each step: kvcache_purge.log, s3_delete.log, db_expunge.log.
- Compliance packet: audit_evidence_template.pdf (attached) + signed attestation PDF.

Tentative schedule: start 2028-03-03 22:00 UTC (off-peak EU) — estimated 4 hours.
Owner: marcus_lin (execution), monica_patel (verification/photo signoff), vivek_kulkarni (compliance approval).

Attachments: deletion_manifest.csv (stub), audit_evidence_template.pdf (stub)

Let me know if they need DocuSign or particular wording for the attestation. Once we run, we'll produce both the manifest and a signed PDF attestation and share via restricted Drive link.

- Marcus
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Subject: Actioned: Deletion completed for Atlas — Evidence attached

Tom / Lena — confirming the deletion for Atlas (atlas-7f2b) was executed on 2028-03-03 22:00 UTC as scheduled. Below is a summary and links to the audit bundle.

What we removed:
- Prompts: expunged from db prompts__atlas (rows removed; ids hashed in manifest).
- Outputs: expunged from outputs__atlas and s3://redwood-logs/eu/atlas-7f2b/ (all versions removed).
- KV cache: shards 13-15 flushed and keys with tag atlas-7f2b removed (kvcache job kvp-4821).
- Runtime logs: ephemeral log groups rotated and scrubbed; aggregated indices refreshed.

Evidence (attached and shared link):
- deletion_manifest.csv — list of deleted object ids (hashed where necessary) plus timestamps.
- s3_delete.log, kvcache_purge.log, db_expunge.log — raw job logs (stored in restricted Drive).
- redwood_deletion_certificate-Atlas.pdf — signed attestation (Vivek Kulkarni, Head of Compliance).
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d/deletion-evidence-Atlas

Notes on verification: we captured S3 delete event IDs and pre-delete SHA256 hashes for files where allowed. The manifest maps these hashes to deleted object IDs; any PII was redacted but marked in the manifest per policy. The KV purge recorded key counts and job exit codes; the purge log contains counts per shard.

If you would like DocuSign for the attestation we can add that post-hoc; Vivek has already countersigned the PDF and it is attached. Please acknowledge and I'll mark the ticket as closed. If DataTek requires additional forensic exports, let us know the exact format and we'll scope it.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
